description: Header file defining structures and constants for x86 CPU context and floating point state in minidump files, used for crash dump analysis.

classes.name: MDFloatingSaveAreaX86
classes.description: Structure representing the floating point save area for x86 architecture, including control, status, tag words, error info, register area, and CR0 NPx state.

classes.name: MDRawContextX86
classes.description: Structure representing the CPU context for x86, including general purpose registers, segment registers, floating point state, debug registers, and extended registers.
